mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 over 3 months signals strong economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during periods of sustained GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in UNRATE above 4% triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns as it signals labor market improvement and reduced unemployment.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive when UNRATE crosses above 4% threshold.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in GDPC1 (demand) and INDPRO (supply) over 3 months amplifies market optimism, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and INDPRO rise >2% and >1% respectively in 3 months
failure_condition: Interaction effect's IC <0.05 over 60-day horizon despite both proxies rising.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in FEDFUNDS below 4% signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive in late-cycle expansions when FEDFUNDS decline occurs.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained monthly increase in INDPRO over 3 months indicates robust supply growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive during sustained supply growth periods.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 5% inflation triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days as investors anticipate higher rates and inflation risks.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not negative when CPIAUCSL spikes above 5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rise in PAYEMS (labor) and GDPC1 (demand) over 3 months signals strong labor market and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises >1% AND GDPC1 rises >2% in 3 months
failure_condition: Interaction effect's IC <0.05 over 20 days despite both proxies rising.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime, a drop in UNRATE below 4% signals labor market recovery, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not positive when UNRATE declines in high-unemployment periods.
